text: January 24, 2024 - The Busa language, also known as Odiai (Uriai), is spoken in three hamlets of northwestern Papua New Guinea. There were 244 speakers at the time of the 2000 census.

title: Odiai | Ethnologue Free
text: Odiai is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It is an isolate that is not known to be related to any other language. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
